repos.descriptionZh: 像Mac应用程序一样在Mac上运行Android应用程序：每个应用程序都在自己的窗口中运行，并在Apple芯片上使用自己的Dock图标。通知、游戏控制器、隐私控制。免费开源（LineageOS + QEMU + scrcpy）。

repos.name: tv-home
repos.description: Debloat a slow, ad-filled Android TV over Wi-Fi and give it a fast Apple TV-style home screen. One prompt for Claude Code, or do it by hand.

repos.name: tv-vibehack
repos.description: Reverse-engineer any Android TV / Google TV: 100% fail-safe direct boot launcher, remote hotkey remapping, Realtek hardware passthrough & offline media player.
repos.descriptionZh: 对任何Android TV/Google TV进行逆向工程： 100%故障安全直接启动启动器、远程热键重新映射、Realtek硬件直通和离线媒体播放器。

repos.name: Tigris
repos.description: Tigris — tvOS 26 style launcher for Android TV: Liquid Glass dock, Top Shelf, glass Control Center, photo screensaver. Agent-installable.
